name: Finale of Promise
oracle_text: You may cast up to one target instant card and/or up to one target sorcery card from your graveyard each with mana value X or less without paying their mana costs. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. If X is 10 or more, copy each of those spells twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.
blocked_sentences: If X is 10 or more, copy each of those spells twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.

needs.what: a free resolution-time cast (cast_from_hand over a target pool, with exiles) that records the stack items of the spells it actually cast under an `as` binding, and a copy_spell that accepts that binding (possibly several spells) so each cast spell is copied `amount` times with new_targets, gated by an `if` on {x} >= 10
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_hand (free, objects + exiles covers the cast and the exile replacement) has no `as` and binds nothing; play_exiled and cast_card do have `as`, but play_exiled reads only exile and cast_card charges the mana cost, and their `as` holds card object ids, not stack sids. copy_spell finds its spell only by `sid` (a single value), a declared spell `target`, or the triggering spell's sid, so it cannot name 'each of those spells' cast during this resolution
